text:
```yaml
name: Claude MD Check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'CLAUDE.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-claude-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check CLAUDE.md character count
        run: |
          CHAR_COUNT=$(wc -m < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "Current CLAUDE.md character count: $CHAR_COUNT"
          if [ $CHAR_COUNT -gt 25000 ]; then
            echo "Error: CLAUDE.md exceeds 25,000 characters limit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "CLAUDE.md size is within acceptable limits"

      - name: Report character count
        run: |
          CHAR_COUNT=$(wc -m < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDER.md character count: $CHAR_COUNT"
          echo "Status: $([[ $CHAR_COUNT -le 25000 ]] && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL')"
```
